data.name: Improved Legendary Influence
data.description: Each legend grants you more of its power in return for greater influence. For each spirit you can channel, choose a second feat other than an item creation feat. Whenever you allow a spirit to gain 1 point of influence over you to gain that spirit's associated feat via Legendary Influence, you can allow that spirit to gain 1 additional point of influence over you to gain the second feat.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Legendary Influence, lesser spirit power and propitiation class features.
